title: Corners and sides
_map: Corners and sides (Y2). Big idea: 2D shapes are described by sides and corners (vertices). Creative: invent a shape with 5 corners. Can a straight-sided shape have only 2 sides?
_story: Steve is building fence shapes for animal pens with straight fence pieces. Ismaeel tries different numbers of sides, finds the pattern (sides = corners), and tests whether 2 sides can make a pen.
_stepChain: triangle and square (shape-detective) → count sides and corners → the pattern: same number → a corner is also called a vertex → try 5, 6, 7 sides → 2 sides can't close

talk.ask: A shape has 6 straight sides. How many corners?
talk.goodAnswer: 6: straight-sided shapes always have the same number of corners as sides.

talk.ask: Can a shape have only 2 straight sides?
talk.goodAnswer: no: two straight lines can't close up into a shape.

handsOn: Use straws or Lego bars to make shapes with 3, 4, 5 and 6 sides. Count the corners each time. Then try to make one with 2 sides!

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: I'm building pens for the animals out of straight fence pieces. A triangle pen uses 3 pieces. What other shapes can I build?
Choose how many straight sides, then tap the hammer to build the pen. Count the corners too. What do you notice?
Every straight-sided shape has the same number of corners as sides. A pointy corner where two sides meet has a special name: a vertex. Lots of corners are called vertices.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: I've only got 2 fence pieces left. I'm going to build a 2-sided pen!

question.prompt: Can 2 straight fence pieces make a closed pen?
question.onRight: Yes, you worked it out. Two straight lines can't close up. The sheep would walk straight out!

0.mistake: hasn't tried closing a two-sided shape
0.hint: Picture two straight lines joined at one end. Can the other ends meet?
0.say: Join 2 straight pieces at one corner. The other two ends point away from each other and never meet. You need at least 3 sides to close a shape.

question.reveal: 2 straight sides can't close. A triangle, with 3, is the fewest.

rule.text: Straight sides = corners. At least 3 sides to close.
rule.ask: Can you say the pattern between sides and corners? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: A straight-sided shape has the same number of corners, or vertices, as sides. And it needs at least 3 sides to close.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: a shape with 100 straight sides. What would it look like?
bonus.reveal: Almost a circle! The more sides, the rounder it looks.
